resolved_findings.finding: Removing one row during a pending restore invalidated the complete callback, dropping pending carried-database associations for other retained missing-folder rows.
resolved_findings.initial_reproduction_contract: Restore missing folders A/B with explicit carried database files, pause the resolver, remove A, release. B must retain its associated carried database.
resolved_findings.resolution: Per-source version snapshots preserve unchanged pending rows. Removal deletes its version; re-add receives a new version. Callback filters checked sources and overrides to matching current versions, while full replacement, clear and shutdown invalidate the whole restore.

resolved_findings.finding: Public apply_workspace_state documentation said only sources were read and missing sources were always dropped.
resolved_findings.resolution: Updated existing public paragraphs describe optional positional databases/mode, original database precedence, async attachment truth, per-source stale guards, workspace-core verification ownership and unchanged logical source roots.

reviewed_contracts: Only explicit equally sized folder-mode source/database lists establish associations; there is no directory-to-file path guess.
An existing original database takes precedence; fallback uses the supplied database only when it is a file and the original database is absent.
Current source order determines database_paths and workspace_state; append order from presence probing cannot reorder the current set.
Filesystem existence/file probes reside in the existing presence worker. GUI callback performs list/dictionary reconciliation and redraw; source label derivation is string-only.
New user additions are not removed by a callback that predates them. Removed/re-added source identities cannot receive stale associations, while unaffected pending sources still resolve.
Replacement, clear and shutdown invalidate pending restoration. Existing summary worker generation handling remains independent.
Original saved document is not mutated by the adapter; digest/containment/refusal decisions remain in the workspace core.
Owner regression uses actual SQLite files, relocation, mixed original/carried order, corruption/unverified/escape refusal and async source-identity cases.
limitations: No code edits or duplicate test execution in this review lane; test summaries are read from the author committed logs.
Logical get_value source roots remain original. This adapter neither reconstructs project folders nor independently makes fresh UMAP pipeline reruns work after relocation.
No native-platform, scientific, model/GPU or whole N180 completion claimed.
Normal API translations/generated artifacts have separate documentation ownership.
